chunks: Al-Hasan, from Zur‘ah, from Sama‘ah, who said:
If a man becomes forgetful in the first two rak‘ahs of al-zuhr and al-‘asr, and does not know whether he has prayed one or two, then he must repeat the salat (prayer).

key_terms.اَلْأَوَّلَتَيْنِ: the first two units of the prayer
key_terms.سَهَا: became forgetful or fell into doubt during prayer

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if someone doubts whether he prayed one or two rak‘ahs in al-zuhr or al-‘asr?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about doubt in the early rak‘ahs of salat (prayer). If a person doubts in the first two rak‘ahs of al-zuhr or al-‘asr and cannot determine whether he prayed one or two, he must repeat the prayer.
